Lower Saxony Prime Minister visits GEO600 in 2017

On 31 January 2017, the Lower Saxony Prime Minister together with other representatives of federal, state, and regional parliaments visited the gravitational-wave detector GEO600 near Sarstedt south of Hanover, Germany.

The GEO600 scientists Harald Lück and Benno Willke informed the visitors about the crucial contributions from GEO600 to the first direct detection of gravitational-waves by the @LIGO@scicomm.xyz instruments on 14 September 2015.
